additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458323-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2 / S0 313905942001] XF4 Charger OCPP Connectivity Issue via WAN Network Configuration CRM:02681000999
additional_info.body:
Dear Roberto,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0458323.
This email is just to summarize our conversation via Teams.
Today I connected remotely via SSH to the charger and checked the settings of the Wired Connection of router XF4 and the Static protocol settings.
After some analysis, the issue was in the "DNS servers", which was left empty. When configuring a Wired connection with Static Protocol, the DNS settings need to be configured to "8.8.8.8".
After I changed the configuration, the charger had a working internet connection, and connected to the Backend without any problem, as you can see form the logs. I attach some pictures from the router settings for reference.
Since the issue is solved, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
